sections.appearance: Kanna has blonde hair tied into a below-chest-length ponytail. She has dog ears (similar to a German Shepherd) and sharp teeth. Her eyes are light blue with her right eye covered by her bangs. Halo ==== See Ogata Kanna. Uniform ==== Kanna wears a white bodysuit with black sides and a navy blue crop jacket that rests on her shoulders, unbuttoned. The jacket features a white line running along the sides of the sleeves. Additionally, she has a red whistle tied with a thin black rope resting on her chest, and a purple band below her elbow. Firearm ==== See Ogata Kanna.
